prompt_fragment:
This asset is an icon. Use crisp, reduced shapes, bold edges, and high readability at very small sizes.
Keep the icon silhouette bold, crisp, and readable at 16px.
raw_description:
A flat app-icon glyph — a seed-like teardrop with two tiny outward-
radiating marks suggesting growth. Aurora cyan-green flat fill.
formatted_prompt: Flat app-icon composition centered on an off-white (#E7E3D5) canvas with generous padding. A bold seed-shaped teardrop glyph, tall and slightly tapered to a gentle point at the top, rendered as a single crisp flat fill in aurora cyan-green. Two small symmetric marks radiate outward from the lower sides of the teardrop, suggesting sprouting growth — each mark a compact flat chevron or short dash shape in burnt sienna (#D97742). Interior detail kept to these three total shapes, all edges sharp vector geometry. No gradients, no textures, no brushwork. High contrast silhouette readable at 16px. Clean modern icon register.
